releases.note: Everything this custom build adds to Orca
features: The main menu has a new «Changelog» item right after «About Orca», listing each release's new features, settings and fixes, with the installed one marked.
A new «Issues» sidebar page lists build-web tasks with Mine, For AI, Favorites, Jira and To work quick filters, status and product filters, search and stars.
Issues → task list shows coloured chips, sortable columns, pages of 50, an assignee column, and status, priority and assignee changeable straight from the row.
Issues → task list marks tasks handed to AI or held by an agent session, and shows subtasks folded under their task with a subtask count.
The Issues sidebar item counts open top-priority blockers among the tasks matching the page's current filters.
Clicking a task in Issues opens a resizable side card where the title, description, steps, status, priority, assignee, release and «handed to AI» are edited in place.
A task opens full screen with Overview, Build, Guide & Jira, Commits and Subtasks tabs, laid out like build-web's own task card.
Task card → Overview has comments with a composer that can also post to Jira, and your own comments can be corrected or deleted.
Task card → Build adopts or creates a run, shows image freshness and progress, and builds, rebuilds, cancels, removes and publishes images, with build logs in a dialog.
Task card → Guide generates and revises the guide live, takes screenshots from a chosen stand, and publishes it to the task's Jira issue.
Task card → Properties sets assignee, product, stand, release, type, priority and build destination, and subtasks inherit the rest from their parent.
Task card → Subtasks lists each subtask with an in-place status, and warns while open subtasks block moving the task onward.
Card panels and commit lists in the full-screen task card resize by dragging or arrow keys, and their widths are remembered per tab.
«Take to work» sends picked tasks to a new Claude session in an existing or new worktree, named after the task keys.
«Take to work» on a task whose session is still open switches to that session instead of starting a second one.
A new «Images» sidebar page shows each image's newest build with filters, sortable columns, build history and push to the registry.
The Images sidebar item counts images building now and, in a red chip, images whose newest build failed.
Images → build dialog starts a new image build, prefilled from the last build, with a «Run tests» option that is off by default.
Images shows each push's progress in a card with per-image results and its log, then refreshes the table when the push finishes.
Images has «in progress» and «failed» filters by last build status, and build logs open in a dialog that follows the newest lines.
A new «Trains» sidebar page lists build-web's build trains with their windows, a «What boards now» preview and a «Depart now» button.
Trains → a history row opens its window in a «Run» dialog with status, images, tasks, errors, publications and the journal on request.
A new «Testing» sidebar page lists tasks in testing whose images are not yet out, with «Check now» and chips showing the work left.
Testing → the work-left chips open the push or build menu directly, and a task opens in a dialog over the list.
A new «Recaps» sidebar page lists finished build-web automation reports, newest first, filterable by product, version, automation and date range.
Recaps → the selected report shows beside the list in a resizable panel, with its charts and diagrams, following Orca's theme.
A new «Git» page shows every branch's commit log with a graph, branch tree, changed files and diffs, plus branch and commit operations.
Custom builds now update from build-web's «Orca» feed instead of GitHub, and an offered update links to build-web's release page.
An app window that is older than its loaded code now asks you to restart instead of showing a cryptic error.
settings: Settings → Notifications has a new «Only When an Agent Needs Input» switch, off by default, limiting alerts and the Dock badge to agents waiting on you.
Settings → Integrations has a Build Web card to connect, test, replace or disconnect build-web and to bring back hidden Issues, Images, Trains, Testing or Recaps items.
fixes: A remote server no longer fails to start its Orca daemon after its third daemon update.
Custom builds can again deploy to servers over SSH and are no longer treated as older than the newest official release.
The Trains sidebar item now appears for people already connected to build-web, following the Issues item until set on its own.
The Issues sidebar item now opens the task list instead of the card left open, and the card's breadcrumb returns to the list.
The Images sidebar count now refreshes within a minute, and immediately on build-web pages or after starting a build.
Long lines in a commit diff now wrap inside their own column instead of running over the other side.
Resizable column splits in task card tabs no longer stop dragging immediately after you start.
